tr.aciklama:
fincosto; restoran, kafe ve çok şubeli işletmelerin günlük operasyonunu tek uygulamada toplar. İşletmeniz fincosto'ya kayıtlıysa size verilen firma kodu ve kişisel PIN'inizle giriş yaparsınız; her çalışan yalnız rolüne açılan ekranları görür.

• Kasa: günlük nakit kaydı, kasa raporu, kasa farkları, POS (Kerzz, ROP) aktarımı
• Personel: işe giriş / çıkış, puantaj, izin ve alacak izin, evrak takibi
• Bordro: maaş, avans, kesinti ve mesai hesapları
• Masraf ve fatura: fiş ile masraf girişi, gelen faturalar, cari hesaplar ve ekstreler
• Stok: günlük sayım, fark raporu, sipariş
• Onay akışı: müdür ve merkez onayları, bildirimler
• Rol ve kart yetkileri: işletme sahibi kimin hangi ekranı göreceğini seçer

Verileriniz işletmenizin kendi Google hesabındaki tablolarda tutulur. PIN'ler şifreli (geri çözülemez özet) saklanır.

Not: fincosto işletmelere yönelik bir hizmettir; uygulamayı kullanmak için işletmenizin fincosto hesabı olmalıdır. Bilgi: baran@fincosto.com
tr.tanitim: Şubelerinizin kasa, personel ve masrafını tek ekrandan takip edin.

inceleme.not:
1. SCREEN RECORDING: attached in the App Review Information section (recorded on a physical iPhone, latest iOS). It starts at app launch and shows: entering the company code, PIN sign-in, the home dashboard, a report, the Approvals tab, and sign-out.

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE: fincosto is a business (B2B) management app for restaurants, cafes and multi-branch food businesses in Turkey. Owners, managers, cashiers and back-office staff use it every day to record daily cash, staff attendance (puantaj), expenses with receipt photos, supplier invoices and stock counts, and to approve these records. It replaces paper forms and spreadsheets and gives owners one consolidated view of all branches.

3. HOW TO ACCESS (demo account, sample data only):
- Open the app. On the first screen enter the company code: demo
- On the next screen enter the PIN shown in the Password field of the sign-in information (6 digits).
- You are signed in as the owner role ("Patron") of the sample company "Demo Restoran" with 2 branches and fictional staff.
- Explore: the home dashboard, the list of all functions (Kasa = cash, Puantaj = attendance, Masraf = expenses, Fatura = invoices), reports, the Approvals tab and the Profile menu (sign-out, change company code).
Accounts: there is no public sign-up. Each business owner creates the accounts of their own staff inside the app (Users screen) and can delete them there; a user can also request deletion from the support e-mail. There is no user-generated content shared publicly and there are no in-app purchases or paid features.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES: Google Apps Script and Google Sheets/Drive (the app's backend and each business's data storage), Cloudflare and GitHub Pages (hosting of app.fincosto.com). Optional POS integrations a business may enable: Kerzz and ROP (restaurant POS systems). No payment processors, no advertising, no analytics SDKs, no AI services.

5. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES: none. The app works the same in all regions; the interface is in Turkish because the current customers are Turkish businesses.

6. REGULATED / THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL: none. The app handles a business's own employee and accounting records, entered by that business.

Distribution: fincosto is a multi-tenant service offered to any restaurant business (not a single company's internal app); new businesses are onboarded by fincosto after contacting baran@fincosto.com.
